{{Top|leg}}
Energized armor drew on the power source of the [[Droid/Legends|droid]] and applied a current through a specially designed matrix on the armor, hence the '''energized armor Mark II''' created a formidable physical barrier. Much more resilient than the [[Droid energized armor Mark I|Mark I]] armor, it was difficult to manufacture and took years to produce, thus it became the most expensive [[droid armor]] on the open market.

==Behind the scenes==
A droid must be at upgrade class 2 to be able to equip this item.
